items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially active vs Raiders after GTD/optimistic calf injury status.
items.why: Optimistic reports Saturday; feeling better, no setbacks.
items.implication: Must-start WR1; full target share expected.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall inactive; was GTD/pessimistic after limited practice on quad.
items.why: Unlikely per sources; not full participant after missing three games.
items.implication: Braelon Allen continues lead role vs MIA.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT in Sunday morning injury summary after prior Questionable status.
items.why: Weekend reports summary; high ankle sprain context from prior.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts again; Ravens pass catchers and Henry face limited ceiling.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT; Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY.
items.why: Weekend reports; Smith/Wicks ruled out for MNF vs DAL.
items.implication: AJ Brown/Goedert usage spike; Saquon volume if active vs soft DAL run D.
items.opportunity: AJ Brown targets/routes; Barkley carries/redzone if in.

items.text: Thinks Cam Skattebo is actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain, despite expected lead role and 124/17/1 production.
items.why: Postgame assessment after ETR watch list.
items.implication: Monitor for next week; Tracy also hamstring.
items.opportunity: If limited next, Tracy or others elevate.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turned on purposeful slide; would have been tilting if actually injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Purposeful slide; ETR watching but Levitan confident.
items.implication: No ROS or weekly concern; continue as RB1.

items.text: Cam Skattebo expected to resume Giants lead back role vs Texans; JJ McCarthy long leash. Produced 124 yards/17 carries/1 TD.
Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs; expected to play Sunday at DET.
items.implication: Immediate RB workload; monitor for rust post-layoff.

items.text: Panthers OT Taylor Moton fractured fibula; out indefinitely after return from blood clot.
items.implication: CAR OL weakened; impacts run game/pass pro for Hubbard etc.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI for usage and matchup; Bears good for yardage, Brown back in real role.
items.why: Usage + Bears secondary matchup; volume with Smith out later confirmed.
items.implication: Strong WR start; elevated with teammates OUT.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET; Lions TE buffet (9 TE TDs allowed, multiple high-scoring TEs).
items.why: DET vulnerable to TEs; Kraft usage.

items.text: Loves volume RBs Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for workloads in friendly matchups.
items.why: Big workloads vs soft run Ds; consistent volume.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (Gonzalez shadow, outside targets) and Josh Downs @ MIN (target share/low-scoring offense).
items.why: Nasty matchups/roles; Odunze low floors, Downs volume issues.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (workload post-layoff) and Cam Skattebo @ HOU (brutal spot).
items.why: Rust for Jacobs; tough matchup for Skattebo.
items.conflict: Jacobs activated/expected; Skattebo produced big but Levitan notes possible hurt.
